description: This file defines classes and types related to test suite and test case management in a testing framework, including Suite and TestCase classes, with methods for serialization, cloning, and hierarchy traversal.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for test suite and test case, holding common properties like title.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, containing nested suites and test cases, with methods for hierarchy management and serialization.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, including its execution results, hierarchy, and metadata.

methods.name: titlePath
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical path of titles leading to the suite or test case.

methods.name: allTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all test cases within the suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _addTest
methods.description: Adds a test case to the suite.

methods.name: _clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the suite or test case.

methods.name: _serialize
methods.description: Serializes the suite or test case to a plain object.

methods.name: _deepParse
methods.description: Parses serialized data into a suite with nested entries.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the associated project, if available.

methods.name: outcome
methods.description: Determines the test case outcome based on results.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns true if the test outcome is expected or flaky.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns the tags associated with the test case.

methods.name: _appendTestResult
methods.description: Adds a new test result entry.

methods.name: _grepBaseTitlePath
methods.description: Builds the base path of titles for grep filtering.

methods.name: _grepTitleWithTags
methods.description: Returns the full title path including tags for filtering.
